name: motion-transitions
description: Example spine transitions: a push, a white flash dissolve and a parameterized wipe reveal, declared as ffmpeg templates with no code.

push.description: Incoming slides in from the right while outgoing slides out left.

wipe_reveal.description: Incoming wipes in from the right over the held outgoing frame.

span.description: Travelled share of the stage width.

flash.description: Outgoing burns to white while incoming dissolves in, fading back from white.
